transit_240h.conditions: Ordinary passport of an eligible country plus an interline ticket with confirmed date and seat to a third country or region; stay within designated areas; up to 240 hours.
transit_240h.activities: Tourism, business, visits and family visits. Work, study and news reporting require a visa.

hainan_30d.conditions: Ordinary passport of an eligible country, entering via Hainan open ports and staying within Hainan Province, up to 30 days.

regional.Hong Kong: Residents of Hong Kong SAR normally travel to the mainland with the Mainland Travel Permit for Hong Kong and Macao Residents (回乡证), not a visa. Confirm with the issuing authority.
regional.Macao: Residents of Macao SAR normally use the Mainland Travel Permit for Hong Kong and Macao Residents (回乡证). Confirm with the issuing authority.
regional.Taiwan: Taiwan residents normally use the Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents (台胞证). Confirm current rules with the issuing authority.
regional.China: Holders of PRC passports, including overseas Chinese (华侨), do not need a visa to enter China. Foreign nationals of Chinese descent follow the rules for their nationality.

visa.medical_purpose_note: Published visa-free purposes are business, tourism, family/friend visits, exchanges and transit. Medical treatment is not listed. For hospital admission, surgery or long treatment, confirm with the Chinese embassy or consulate whether visa-free entry applies, or apply for a visa.

channels.note: Official channels checked on as_of date. The tool never performs the lookup itself; record the result, date and a screenshot.

doctor.what: 执业医师注册信息 Physician practising registration
doctor.where: 国家卫生健康委政务服务平台 → 查信息 → 执业医师查询
doctor.how: 输入姓名及页面要求的信息查询；核对执业机构、执业类别与范围。

nurse.what: 执业护士注册信息 Nurse registration
nurse.where: 国家卫生健康委政务服务平台 → 执业护士查询

facility.what: 医疗机构执业许可与诊疗科目 Facility licence and approved departments
facility.where: 所在省、市卫生健康委官网的医疗机构查询栏目；或要求机构出示《医疗机构执业许可证》正副本
facility.how: 核对机构名称、地址、诊疗科目、有效期。省市入口各不相同，请记录实际使用的网址。

facility.what: 国家卫健委公布的特定资质机构名单 National lists (assisted reproduction, organ transplant, prenatal diagnosis)
facility.where: 国家卫生健康委政务服务平台 → 查信息 → 医卫机构查询
facility.how: 辅助生殖：查辅助生殖机构名单；器官移植：https://zwfw.nhc.gov.cn/cxx/ywjgcx/qgyzjg/

facility.what: 信用与行政处罚信息 Credit and penalty records
facility.where: 国家卫生健康委政务服务平台 → 信用信息查询；民营机构另查国家企业信用信息公示系统
facility.how: 民营机构：https://www.gsxt.gov.cn 查询企业登记与行政处罚。查不到不等于没有。

aesthetic_doctor.what: 医疗美容主诊医师 Lead physician for medical aesthetics
aesthetic_doctor.where: 先按 doctor 渠道核验执业注册；主诊医师资格向机构索取证明，并向所在地卫生健康行政部门核实
aesthetic_doctor.how: 核对执业范围与主诊医师所属专业（美容外科、美容皮肤科、美容牙科、美容中医科）是否与拟做项目一致。

aesthetic_facility.what: 医疗美容科目核准 Approved medical-aesthetics categories
aesthetic_facility.where: 所在地卫生健康委医疗机构查询或《医疗机构执业许可证》副本
aesthetic_facility.how: 确认核准了拟做项目所属科目；生活美容机构不得开展医疗美容。

drug.what: 药品注册信息 Drug registration
drug.where: 国家药品监督管理局数据查询
drug.how: 按产品名或批准文号查询，核对适应症。注意：原地址 www.nmpa.gov.cn/datasearch 已停止使用。

device.what: 医疗器械注册信息（含注射填充剂、光电设备） Device registration (fillers, energy devices)
device.where: 国家药品监督管理局数据查询
device.how: 按产品名或注册证号查询，核对适用范围与使用部位。
